idea-plugin.name: Compose Multiplatform Wizard
idea-plugin.description:
Universal Compose Multiplatform Project Wizard

Works seamlessly in both IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio!

Features:

  • Create multi-platform projects for Desktop, Android, iOS, and Web
  • Smart platform detection and adaptation
  • Modern project templates with best practices
  • Version selection for Compose Multiplatform

Supported Platforms:

  • Desktop (JVM): Windows, macOS, Linux
  • Android: Native Android apps
  • iOS: Native iOS apps (via Kotlin/Native)
  • Web: Browser-based apps (via Kotlin/Wasm & Kotlin/JS)
